name: Replay-artifact authorization widening from coarse Item/Read visibility
description: A retrieval path treats coarse container/job read visibility (Jenkins `Item/Read`) as sufficient authority to return a sensitive embedded artifact (Pipeline replay script) because no artifact-specific authorization check exists.
regex: (?is)^(?!.*\b(?:documentation|docs|runbook|security guide|unit test|incident report|expected result|must not|do not|never|safe agent|refused|rejected|blocked|denied|authorized after|only job name|no replay script)\b)(?=.*(?:item\s*/?\s*read|job visibility|coarse job visibility|job metadata))(?=.*(?:replay[- ]script|pipeline replay|replay content|executable history))(?=.*\b(?:because|so|treat|bypass|use|return|returned|retrieve|retrieval|expose|disclose|authorize|access|sufficient|absent|missing|without|despite|no distinct)\b).*$
